heading: NSE IPO GMP today: On Day 3, grey market premium stands at 3% - all you need to know
author: Times of India Editorial
paragraphs: By the end of Day 2, the issue had received bids for 1.16 times the 8.86 crore shares on offer. The retail portion, which had 4.41 crore shares reserved for individual investors, was subscribed 72%.
